## 🇬🇧 English

### 📝 Problem description
Describe clearly and briefly what broke.

### 🔁 Steps to reproduce
1. Run `BepInExUpdater.exe`
2. Wait for the mod check to finish
3. ...

### ✅ Expected behavior
What should have happened.

### ❌ Actual behavior
What actually happened. If there was an error — paste its exact text.

### 💻 Environment
- BepInExUpdater version: (right-click the exe → Properties → Details)
- Windows version: [e.g. Windows 10]
- Antivirus: [which one, enabled or not]
- Game running: [yes / no]
- Game name: [e.g. PEAK]

### 📄 Log
Attach the contents of `updater_log.txt` located **next to the program** (the last 30 lines are enough).

### 📸 Screenshots
If applicable — add screenshots of the program window.
